paite: Joshua sih nung in hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante'n, "Kanaante dou a ei a dia hon sualsak ding in kua akuantou masa dia?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi.
heading: Judah Leh Simeon Namte'n Adoni-bezek Aman Uh
english: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of Yahweh, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Judah va kuan hen. Ngai un, akhut ah gam ka peta," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”

paite: Judah in a-unau Simeon kiang ah, "Kanaante dou ding in ka gam tantuam ah hong paitou in. Kei leng na gam tantuam ah ka hong pai sam ding," achi hi. Huchi in Simeon akiang ah ahohta hi.
english: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.

paite: Huchi in Judah ava hoh a; Kanaante leh Perizte TOUPA'N akhut uah apeta hi. Bezek ah mi singkhat athat uhi.
english: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.

paite: Bezek ah Adoni- bezek amu ua, adou ua, Kanaante leh Perizte athat uhi.
english: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

paite: Himahleh Adoni-bezek atai a; anungdelh ua, aman ua, akhutpi leh akhepi atansak uhi.
english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

paite: Adoni-bezek in, "Kumpipa sawmsagihte khutpi leh khepi ka tankhiaksakte'n ka dohkan nuai ah anneng atawm uh. Ka hih bang geih a Pathian in hon thuk ahita ve," achi hi. Jerusalem ah api ua, huai ah asita hi.
english: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

paite: Judah suante'n Jerusalem khua dou in ala ua, namsau a sual in akhopi ahal uhi.
heading: Judah Nam In Jerusalem Leh Hebron Azou
english: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

paite: Huai nung in Judah suante tanggam simlam leh phaizang a teng Kanaante dou ding in akuansuk uhi.
english: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

paite: Judah in Kanaante Hebron a tengte ava dou a, (ama in Hebron min Kiriath-arba ahi) Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai athat uhi.
english: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

paite: Huai a pan Debir khomite adou uh, ama in Debir kho min Kiriath-sepher ahi.
heading: Othniel In Debir Khopi Azou / (Jos 15.13-19)
english: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

paite: Kaleb in, "Kuapeuh Kiriath-sepher khua dou a, la peuhmah ka tanu Aksah azi ding in ka pe ding," achi hi.
english: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”

paite: Kaleb nau Kenaji tapa Othniel in alazou a, azi ding in atanu Aksah apeta hi.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.

paite: uan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ava tun in gam ngen thei ding in apa akunzou hi. Sabiltung a pan akumkhia a; Kaleb in akiang ah, "Bang na deih a?" achi hi.
english: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Hon vualzawl in. Simlam gam lah na hon peta ngal a, tui nak neite leng hon pe lai in," achi hi. Kaleb in tui nak nei tungnungte leh khangnungte apeta hi.
english: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

paite: Mosi puzon Ken suante Arad simlam a om Judah gamdai ah Judah suante toh tum sing khopi a pan ahohtou ua; mipite lak ah ava teng uhi.
heading: Judah Leh Benjamin Namte Vualzohnate
english: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.

paite: Judah bel a-unau Simeon toh akisa ua, Zephath a om Kanaante ava that ua, ahihchimit vek uhi. Huai khopi min Hormah chih ahi.
english: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.

paite: Judah in Gaza khua leh abialte, Ashkelon khua leh abialte leh Ekron khua leh abialte tan in ala hi.
english: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

paite: TOUPA Judah kiang ah a-om a; tanggam a tengte adelhkhia a; phaizang a tengte bel sik kangtalaite aneih ziak un adelhkhe zou kei hi.
english: Yahweh was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

paite: Mosi in ana gensa bang in Hebron khua Kaleb apia ua, ama'n huai a pan Anak tapa thumte adelhkhia hi.
english: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.

paite: Benjamin suante'n Jebuste, Jerusalem a tengte adelhkhe kei ua, Jebuste Benjamin suante toh tuni tan in Jerusalem ah atengkhawm uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

paite: Joseph inkuante leng Bethel khua dou ding in akisatou ua, akiang uah TOUPA a-om hi.
heading: Epraim Leh Manasseh Nam In Bethel Azou
english: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.

paite: Joseph inkuante'n Bethel ah enkhe mite asawl uhi. Ama in huai kho min Luz ahi.
english: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)

paite: Enkhe mite'n mi khat khosung a pan hong pawtkhia amu ua, akiang ah, "Hehpih in khopi sung lutna hon ensak dih ve, huchi in ka hon hehpih ding uh," achi uhi,
english: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”

paite: Khopi sung lutna a-ensak a, namsau in huai khua adou ua; huai mipa leh a-inkuanpihte teng bel ahinghawi uhi,
english: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.

paite: Huai mipa Hitte gam a lut in khua asat a, huai kho min Luz asa a; tuni tan in hiai min apu lai hi.
english: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.

paite: Manasseh in Beth-shean khua leh akhopel a tengte, Taanak khua leh akhopel a tengte, Dor khua leh akhopel a tengte, Ibleam khua leh akhopel a tengte, Meggiddo khua leh akhopel a tengte adelhkhe kei hi. Huai gam ah Kanaante ateng uhi.
heading: Israel Mite'n Ahawlkhiak Louh Mite
english: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante ahong hat un anasem ding un Kanaante a omsak ua, adelhkhe siang vek kei uhi.
english: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

paite: Ephraim in Gezer a teng Kanaante adelhkhe kei a; Gezer ah alak uah Kanaante ateng zawta uh.
english: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

paite: Zebulun in Kitron a tengte leh Nahalol a tengte adelhkhe kei a; Kanaante alak uah ateng sam ua, anasem ding un a-om zawta uhi.
english: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.

paite: Asher in Akko a tengte, Zidon a tengte, Ahlab a tengte, Akjib a tengte, Helbah a tengte, Aphik a tengte leh Rehob a tengte adelhkhe kei hi.
english: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;

paite: Asher suante huai gam a teng Kanaante lak ah ateng samta uhi; amau lah adelhkhe ngal kei ua.
english: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.

paite: Naphtali in Beth-shemesh a tengte, Beth-anath a tengte adelhkhe kei. Huai gam a teng Kanaante lak ah ateng samta uhi. Beth-shemesh a tengte leh Beth-anath a tengte nasem ding in a-omta uhi.
english: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.

paite: Amorte'n Dan suante tanggam ah ahawltou uh; phaizang a apaisuk uh aphal ngal kei ua.
english: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;

paite: Amorte Aijalon a Heres tang leh Shaalbim ah ateng ua, Joseph inkuante'n amau azou ua, anasem ding un alak uah ateng uhi.
english: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.

paite: Amorte gam chiang Akrabbim tungkahna a pan, suangpi a pan leh Sela a pan ahi.
english: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
